balls.text: ends with a dot ball. Back of a length on middle. Backs away to club a pull. Ball goes over the blade and CSK finish on 134 for 6
full toss, on off stump. He backs away and lofts it over cover. One hand off the bat as he plays it, getting enough air in the shot to get it down for four
legcutter. Length ball wide outside off. Bravo had backed away exposing all three stumps but this was wide irrespective of where Bravo stood
full just outside off. Jadeja goes deep in his crease and slogs to deep midwicket
excellent innings comes to a close as the pull is top-edged in the air. Rahul gets under it with the gloves on as Shami goes slow and short
hammered! Ten off the first two. Flat-bats this length ball over the non-striker's head to long on. Hits the boundary skirting on the full
dragged through the gap! du Plessis is giving CSK some momentum before the break. Length ball outside off and he moves to the leg side before swiping a cross-batted shot through deep midwicket
full and wide outside off. Mistimed to cover for a single
that's a biggie! Full on off. Faf clears the front leg and hits a booming six over wide long on! 100m long, how about that?!

yorker attempted. Late swing into the pads. Looks to flick leg side, misses, hits the pad. Ball rolls away to the keeper and off they go for a quick run. But with nothing much to lose, Rahul chooses to review for lbw after the umpire gives it a not out and gives "bat runs". Replays say there's no bat but the angle of the bowler means that the ball is kissing leg stump. Umpire's call on stump impact, so it remains not out
overpitched outside off. Sticks the bat out and guides it to deep point
back of a length outside off stump. Angling away. Looks to pull but misses
full outside off from over the stumps. Drilled to Brar at deep extra cover
overpitched, misses the yorker, ends up as a low full toss. du Plessis thrashes it back past Jordan, and the over ends with another four down the ground! Expensive end to the over
length ball on off. Angling into his pads, and thumped by moving to the leg side through deep midwicket
good length, on off. Checks a pull to wide long on, but smart captaincy from Rahul to keep Mayank at that position for Jadeja's leg-side swipes
that's the fifty - his 21st in IPL. Nearly a yorker outside off. Dug away to mid off
slower ball, on a good length. Jadeja looks to pull, but poor timing. Hit to Mayank at deep midwicket
back of a length on off, and pulled to deep midwicket for one
full toss, but pace off. Mistimed slog to long on's right for one
overpitched outside off, and he shovels a drive over the infield. Doesn't have the legs to go for four though

tough chance but dropped! Full outside off, but it's the slower ball. Faf looks to club a shot straight down the ground but mistimes it towards the bowler instead. Hits Arshdeep's palm but falls out. Arshdeep has taken blinders before off his own bowling so he will be disappointed
edged over short third man! Full ball outside off. Angling further away. Faf gets down on one knee to lift it inside out over cover but his timing is absolutely off
short slower ball. Back of a length on middle and loops way over Faf. Rahul collects on the bounce

back of a length on off and angling into middle. Cramping him for space, but manages to nudge it to midwicket. Arshdeep runs across from his followthrough, and his commitment ensures that these two can't pinch a double
full just outside off. Slower ball and tapped to cover for a single

full ball on off and turning further away. Jadeja stretches out to cut but is beaten by the turn. Taken by Rahul near the tramlines, but umpire says thats a legal ball. Bishnoi's spell ends and that takes us to another time out
full on middle. The googly is flicked off the back foot to deep backward square leg
full outside off. A zipping delivery. Dip and turn, spinning away from Faf after landing. Tries to go over cover but the ball whizzes past the outside edge
full on off, and he flicks this to wide long on. Jordan runs around and throws it back but can't stop the two
full on middle stump. Quicker one, and fended back with soft hands
full around leg and skidding through. Flicked off the back foot to short fine kleg for one
good length outside off. Wants to cut but too close to his body. Struck in front of square
full on middle, and clipped to deep midwicket for one
full just outside off. Comes down the ground to tee off, but can only drag a shot down to long on
good length, on off. Gets the front leg to the on side and then pulls along the ground through midwicket for four! Spotted the shorter ball early, and then had to get his timing right
full on middle, and nudged off his pads to midwicket. Brar has to run to the area to intercept himself
good length, on leg. Paddled to short fine leg
back of a length on off, and angling into his chest. Nudged square to square leg for a jogging single

around the stumps again. Back of a length outside off. Jadeja sticks the bat out to guide a late cut. Shami is at short third man, but the ball has been played to his left. Can't stop, and that's four to CSK
over the stumps again. Full and wide, and he slaps a drive to deep point

around the stumps. Full toss outside off, and he caresses a drive to mid off. But Jadeja wants to run to the dangerous end....successfully done in the end! Would've been safe even if it was a direct hit
not full enough. Just outside off. Swiped across the line to Arshdeep at deep midwicket
full ball on leg, but going down the leg side. Rahul can't grab it with the gloves but can get a leg to it. Padded away by the keeper
full ball just outside off, and driven firmly. But cover is lurking
full on middle, and he flicks to deep midwicket. Chance of two, but they settle for one
full on middle. Jadeja tentatively taps it to cover's left for a quick single
good length on middle. Angling across. Jadeja defends off the back foot by nudging it to the left of Brar
good length outside off. Nudged towards the off side with soft hands
full and wide, and cuts it square. Henriques at cover gets a hand to it, but can't stop the single
fullish outside off, from around the stumps. Faf rocks back and cuts square. Ball rolls just past cover point who did not commit to the dive. Fielder in the deep has to run in and keep it down to two

googled! Bishnoi brings out the big wrong'un for the last ball of the over after delivering legbreaks to Dhoni for most of the over. Full outside off, turning in, and Dhoni drives away from his body. Inside edge, and it rolls back onto the stumps.
full outside off. Turning away, and the drive is struck to long off
full on middle, and nudged off his toes to the vacant midwicket region for a single
full on middle. Skidding through. Defended back with soft hands
full just outside off. Turning away. Pushes at it. Edged to short third man
slapped and its flat! Nearly six, one bounce to extra cover for four. Bishnoi goes loopy, full and wide, and Dhoni crunches it square. Powerfully struck
full on off. Pushed to the left of Brar, but he dives to his left to stop it. Only 2 off the over
angling down the leg side this time. du Plessis did try to flick it fine but misses. Ball hits Rahul's pad and rolls away to short fine leg
length ball on off and angling in. Stays on the back foot and nudges a flick to midwicket
full on off, and it skids in with the arm. Dhoni looks to defend off the front foot. Another inside-edge onto his front leg
full outside off. Dhoni skips down the ground and looks to play straight. But inside edged onto his pads
good length on middle, and angling into leg. Tries to flick off the back foot. Misses. Hits the pad
full outside off, and Dhoni leans into a drive. Struck to cover
tossed up very full on off, and jammed back to the bowler
shorter in length, and wide of off. Finally gets the boundary after beating the man in the deep to his right. That was there for the taking, and he plays from deep in his crease
tossed up full and outside off. Drilled to deep point
beaten on the outside edge! Full ball outside off, and Dhoni misses his drive as the ball goespast his outside edge after a hint of turn away
skips down again, and blocks this full ball on off
he skips down first ball to this flighted ball wide of off, and plays it like a full-toss toward short third man. The man there dives to his right, but doesn't get a hand
good length ball on middle, and climbing on to him. Blocked toward square leg

this is fuller and a touch wide of off. du Plessis looks to flash at that away from his body, but doesn't connect. There was an appeal for caught behind by Punjab, but not given. Rahul thinks about a review, but doesn't go for it in the end
slightly fuller in length, but this one pitches outside leg and continues to angle down further. Wide delivery
opens the bat face to guide that good length ball outside off to third man

nabbed at deep point! Arshdeep at the boundary was running to his left, and completed the take to his left after Rayudu made room to this short delivery on middle and off, and looked to flash at that. The ball instead took off from near the top edge - perhaps an indication that there is still life in the pitch - and landed well into the hands of Arshdeep
nearly chopped on! Looks to guide that full delivery outside off toward third man, but gets a bottom edge that just about lands it behind the stumps
full delivery slightly wide of off, and slashed to deep point
full ball outside off, and clipped to deep midwicket with the closed face of the bat
tossed up very full and very wide of off. Left alone, and called a wide
much fuller and outside off, and he opens the bat face to guide that to deep point. The man at point dives to his left, but doesn't get a hand
short of a length and wide of off, and cut away to deep point
fuller ball outside off, and driven to deep point with the full face of the bat
Rahul appeals for caught behind, but not given! Good length ball on middle, and turning into the batter, who misses his flick. Not given wide either, with the ball ending outisde leg
bowls on a shortish length outside off, as du Plessis nudges that toward point
good length ball on off, and angling in. du Plessis skips in his crease to guide that to third man, and almost collides with Rayudu while running toward the other end

Uthappa goes to pull this short ball, and Brar takes a very good catch at deep square leg! Short delivery outside off, and he pulls from almost middle, with his front leg in the air. Brar in the deep has to go low to his left to complete the take, as Uthappa gets height without any distance, the ball having come off the higher part of his bat
fuller and just outside off, and driven to the man at midwicket with the closed face of the bat
another good length ball outside off, as du Plessis drives to deep point with the full face of the bat
good length ball just outside off, and pushed toward long-on after a slight step across off
beats Uthappa first ball! Good length ball a touch wide of off, as Uthappa looks to poke at that but is beaten
goes on a back of a length outside off again, as this time Uthappa manages to run it down to third man
goes on a good length just outside off, as it is tapped toward point after opening the bat face

outside edge, and tickled behind to Rahul! Moeen had faced five dots in a row, and looked to guide this good length ball just outside off down to third man with his bat face slightly open. Still no good score for Moeen in the UAE, as he plays without much foot movement
slower ball on a fullish length on off. Tapped toward point for a quick single
pulls this short delivery to deep square leg! Arshdeep perhaps over-compensates for the previous ball, and goes short on middle to pull to fine leg's left
slower ball, and pushed back aerially between Moeen and the man at mid-off! That is overpitched on a full length on middle and off, and he presents the full face of the bat to drive at that

change of pace on a fullish length on off. Moeen lets that come to him before opening the bat face to push that to point. Just one off the over, with Shami having conceded just six runs off his first three overs
much fuller on off, and Moeen drives forward aerially to mid-off. Another dot ball for Moeen
another good length ball on off, and blocked toward cover
pulls, but just short of mid-on! Shami goes short to Moeen early - as expected - and pitches it on middle, as Moeen nearly takes his eyes off while pulling
back of a length ball just outside off, and patted to the on side slightly away from his body and without any foot movement

bowls on a good length on middle and leg, and he sets off after flicking to the man at square leg. Rapid call of a single there, as Moeen is home despite the threat of throw at the keeper's end, which doesn't hit the stumps

another slower ball on a fullish ball just outside off, as he dabs that delicately to short third man. Mayank there dives to his left to stop three runs, as du Plessis takes off amidst calls of "yes, yes Mo"

bowls short of a length, and Gaikwad pulls right to midwicket! The ball seemed to have rushed to him after pitching short on middle, but there was good bounce too. He almost sliced the bat to pull, and got a top edge, with Shahrukh taking a step to his right to complete the catch
makes room and takes a step down the pitch to slam that good length ball on middle and off flat-batted to mid-off
slower ball on a fullish length just outside off. Tapped to point after waiting for the ball to come
fuller ball on his pads, and clipped to beat short fine leg to his left. Two runs gobbled toward long leg
goes on a good length on leg, as du Plessis turns that behind to short fine leg, who takes a few steps forward to collect the ball
leading edge flies to third man, where Arshdeep scampers to his left to take it on the bounce. Fullish ball on off, and du Plessis was early into his shot
yorker length delivery just outside off at 139kph, and drilled toward mid-on with a horizontal bat
looks to ramp that good length ball wide of off, but doesn't connect since he is far too across off while playing at that. The ball runs down to Rahul instead
goes back to that back of a length delivery on middle. Clipped toward square leg, with his bottom hand coming off late
bowls fuller and just outside off. He taps at that late, and finds point again
good length ball on off, and he opens the bat face to guide that to point
takes a step down, but pushes this full ball on off to the man at cover
good length ball on leg, and clipped toward square leg
sweeps to short fine leg on the bounce! Goes low and across to slog that full ball on off, but doesn't connect
full and wide of off leg. Rahul can't collect cleanly, and they pinch another run
skids on with the arm, as Brar goes fuller on leg. du Plessis goes low to tap at that
Henriques at cover-point dives to his left and saves three! Short ball on middle, and Gaikwad cuts it forcefully
comes down first ball, and launches that over mid-on! Jordan turned around and ran, but just about failed to stop the ball from crossing after he couldn't get a hand while trying to pull that back
good length ball on middle, and cramps him for room. du Plessis defends back to the bowler
takes half step down to this short of a length on middle, which in angling. Shami fires at 141kph, as the ball balloons off Gaikwad's gloves to land across Rahul's right
another inside edge on to his front pad, as he looks to block this fullish ball on middle. Shami has his hands on his head after that
gets an inside edge on to his pads to this good length ball on middle
full ball on middle, and pushed toward mid-on for a rapid run. Mid-on runs forward, but can't collect the ball cleanly
fullish delivery on his pads, and clipped to fine leg to get off the mark

glory shot and that helps Punjab Kings finish the game in style. Length ball outside off, and he swivels to hammer a six over deep midwicket! Not perfectly hit, but enough to beat the outfielder on the boundary line. Punjab Kings with by six wickets as KL Rahul stays unbeaten on 98.

good length ball outside off stump. Pulled along the ground to wide long on, and Bravo runs in from the deep to stop the double but he fails to pick the ball up! Goes past his fingertips, and hits the boundary skirting.
good length outside off stump. Guided to third man for a single
full on off, and he slogs to deep midwicket for a couple
good length outside off. Henriques walks across to the off side to play a cheeky paddle past the leg stump. Ends up flicking the shot onto his boots. Shardul collects swiftly
another one for Thakur as this length ball on the corridor of uncertainty gets Markram. He expected the ball to angle in, and wanted to thrash a drive through cover. Edged to Dhoni
full, slower ball, outside leg stump. Rahul moves to the leg side and flicks to deep midwicket.
yorker length, outside leg stump. Nudged away to deep midwicket off his toes to deep midwicket
good length ball outside off and angling even further away. No shot offered, and wide run collected
slower ball, full on leg. Nudged to long on with very soft hands, allowing him to take the second run
long on is a spectator! Full ball on middle. Rahul simply brings the bat down to hit through the line. Amazing timing, and the bat swing has the ball deposited over Hazlewood down the ground
wayward line. Slower ball doesn't come out right. Lands beyond the 22 yards, and that too outside leg stump
flicked nonchalantly! What beautiful wrists. Full toss, low on leg stump. Rahul breaks his wrists to flick it for six beyond Chahar at fine leg.
around the stumps. Length ball on middle and leg. Rahul opens up the leg side and muscles a shot over square leg to the fielder in the deep. Gaikwad slides around the boundary line to intercept
good length, outside off. Mistimes a cross-batted swiped to long on for one
good length wide outside off. Looks to cut square but misses. Past the blade to Dhoni
full just outside off stump. Checks a flick, and bunts it to mid on for a quick run
slapped over cover point. Back of a length outside off, and he cuts it but unconvincingly
knuckle ball, full and wide. Rahul throws his bat at this to slap a shot to deep extra cover

swatted away! In the slot, outside off, and Rahul shuffles the front leg out of the ball's way before hammering a shot over Chahar's head. Team hundred as Chahar's economy is now nearly 13. This one is 101m!
full and wide. Rahul offers no shot but that's because he knows its going beyond the tramlines. Wide given
good length slower ball. Bunted with a flick to wide long on for one
full and wide outside off. Slaps a shot past the bowler's left. Santner, the sub, dives to his right from mid off to intercept
swatted away! Length ball outside off, and Markram gets in position early to drag a pull across the line. Over deep midwicket!
good length on middle stump, around the wickets. Uses the wrists to flick to deep midwicket for a jogging single
fullish on off, from over the stumps. Bit of a slower ball. Mistimed drive past Rahul to long on
shouts of catch it but drops well short of Chahar at fine leg. Short ball on leg and he mistimes the pull
full toss on leg stump from around the stumps. Paddles it behind square to fine leg for a single

taken at long-on! The short of a length ball outside off gets big on Shahrukh, as Chahar bowls a touch wide of off. Shahrukh pulls, and gets that from the toe end of the bat while almost slicing the bat
tries to repeat that, but this ball is shorter and wider of off. Ends up skying that over midwicket, where Rayudu thinks he has a chance for a moment
laps that way into the stands over fine leg! In fact, that lands in the top tier! Rahul goes across off, and goes down on his back knee to slog that full ball outside off. Nice pick-up shot
pushes this good length ball outside off toward deep midwicket
beaten outside off! Good length ball on off, and that shapes away after pitching, as Shahrukh jabs at that, but the ball passes his outside edge
reaches out for this full ball wide of off, and slams that to deep point
quicker and fuller on middle. That was delivered at 109kph, and bunted back to the bowler

fired over wide long-on! Absolutely clobbers that length ball on off after clearing his front leg and smashing full throttle. A new ball is being asked for now, after he hit the previous one away to 95 meters
makes room to this short delivery outside leg, and cuts that to deep point
clips this fullish ball on his pads to deep square leg
good length ball on off, and pushed back to the bowler
very full on middle after he tosses it up, as Rahul drags that to long-on to raise his fifty off 25 balls
caresses that gently to deep point, as Thakur goes full and outside off
pushes this fuller ball on off back to Thakur, who again gets his right hand to it
punches this beyond deep point! Good timing and placement. The ball is on a good length outside off, and he guides that for four to the left of the man at point
whacked over for six to long leg! Effortless from Rahul. This is bowled fullish on leg and with a scrambled seam, as Rahul flicks using his bottom hand
fuller ball outside off, and pushed back with the closed face of the bat. Thakur gets his right hand to that
good length ball on off, and he drives to cover with the full face of the bat
and again! Goes for the hills, and misses again. This is fuller and just outside off, and he heaves in vain
swing and a miss! Hazlewood fires a short of a length ball outside off at 140kph, and Shahrukh is beaten on his pull
back of a length again outside off, and good bounce there. Shahrukh dabs that off his glove to the on side
opens the bat face to run this good length ball outside off to run that down to third man
gets a leading edge to point, as he fends at that good length ball on off, perhaps surprised by the extra bounce
gorgeously lofted over mid-off! Presents the full face of the bat to this full delivery outside off, which is right in his arc. The ball came off the bottom half of the bat, but was still four

leading edge, and skied to mid-off! Good take by du Plessis falling over to his right. It was with a scrambled seam by Thakur, and on a good length on middle and off. Sarfaraz looks to flick that across the line, and sends that sailing over for an easy catch. Punjab lose another in the poweprlay
good length ball on off, and clipped to the man at midwicket
fullish ball outside off, and angling away. Tapped to point, who  dives to his left to stop that

strikes him on the front pad, and he is given leg before! And Mayank doesn't decide to review after much thought. Good length ball on middle and leg, and Mayank is almost across while trying to flick to the on side. Replays show the ball was missing leg
pulled to mid-on on a couple of bounces. Thakur goes short on off, and Mayank plays without great timing
outside edge, and flies between point and short third man! Looks to heave this good length ball outside off, and he ends up getting an edge in the gap there
back of a length again on off, and nudged to Moeen again
cracked milessss over deep square leg! Another short of a length ball on off, and Rahul sends that with a pleasing sound off his bat. Stays deep in his crease, and rocks that pull
good length delivery just outside off, and he opens the bat face to tap that to Moeen, who is stationed as a wide-ish gully
pulled to fine leg on the bounce! This ball is short of a length on middle and leg, and Rahul dispatches that behind the wicket, with the ball hitting his bat just below his gloves
launched over the bowler's head! That was in the slot on a full length on off, and he lofted that with the free swing of the arms for four
good diving stop by the cover fielder Rayudu to his left, but he then concedes an overthrow at the striker's end. Mayank drives at this full ball outside off, but doesn't beat the fielder
cuts away this good length ball wide of off to deep point

whips that short delivery to deep midwicket! Deepak lands it short on off, and Mayank stays deep in his crease to pull that using his bottom hand. Deep square runs to his left, but the ball beats him easily
misses his pull! Short delivery again outside off, and there is good bounce as Mayank swings and misses
back of a length ball outside off, and clipped toward midwicket with the closed face of the bat

goes for the pull again to this short delivery on middle and off, and lands that toward deep midwicket. There is no on the fence there, and so he is safe. Not quite off the middle, but a few runs still
pulls with authority! Good length delivery on leg, and he simply slaps that pull elegantly with the full swing of the arms with his front foot a bit in the air
outside edge, and the ball flies to third man! The point fielder leaps to his left, but doesn't get a hand. Another good length ball outside off, and Rahul gets an outside edge to his drive
short of a length on middle and off again, and Rahul has his bottom hand off as he taps that to point. Mayank took for a run, but was sent back

looks to pull, but his helmet is out of order after he misses! Short of a length ball on off, and he pulls but gets a top edge bang on his grille. He was standing outside his crease to the ball aleady. A concussion test awaits, as is the norm. But all seems good, as Rahul will continue
full ball on off, and pushed to cover with the open face of the bat
drills this very full ball on middle to mid-off after making room. Completes a quick run in the end
good length, and good bounce. Just over stump off, as he looks to poke at that ball in the channel
chipped off the outside edge between point and short third man! Good length ball just outside off, and he looks to drive on the up, but gets the outside edge flying behind for four
fuller ball outside leg, and wide called. Dhoni dives to his left to stop that

slices that over cover, and bags four! The ball is full outside off, and in the length to help him loft with room available. He opens the bat face after the ball angles away from him, and lifts that for four
this is on a good length on middle and off, and he dabs that to third man very close to his body
pushed to point on the bounce! Fullish ball just outside off, and driven on the up with the full face of the bat
yorker length ball outside off, and jammed toward cover
full delivery on off, and he presents the full face of the bat to drive that between cover and mid-off. Bravo at mid-off slides to his left to stop that
